material:
name: pwn
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: greet
        run: echo "${{ github.event.comment.body }}"
